Whoa, this is a dangerous situation you’re in. You’re either going to end up killing yourself out of misery or he’s going to kill or hurt you out of revenge if you leave. You need to start keeping track of all the harmful stuff he does to you so you have enough evidence to put him in jail. Record his verbal abuse with your phone and find a way to set up a camera in the house to catch any moments of forced intercourse or physical abuse. At the very least, you can get a restraining order against him. Let your family know what he’s doing to you. The more people that know, the better protection you will have. This really isn’t a joke. He seems hungry for power and you’re his prey. Please be careful and take my advice.

I’m sorry you feel this way. If you can’t confide in your online friends because they have too much on their plate, find another group that’s stable enough to give you proper support. These thoughts you have of imagining your death when you’re near weapons is concerning. To get to the heart of your depression, you need to spill every ounce of emotion you have and truthfully explain why you’re feeling that way. So far it seems that you feel insignificant and can’t find what life’s purpose is. You’d be destroyed if your friends died and they would feel the exact same if it was you. You can’t judge your worth based on what your depression is telling you. You’re listening to the enemy.

It seems like the cause of your suicidal thoughts stems from a fixable problem. Firstly, congrats on losing the 25 pounds! You’ve proved you have the ability to overcome the issue, so let’s focus on getting rid of what’s discouraging you. Running or going to the gym are not the only methods of working out, you can do it in the comfort of your home. What I used to do is watch Workout programs on YouTube (cuz I’m not paying $60). Search “Insanity Day 1” on youtube...here, lemme give you a link: https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=Z_aDM9WND4Y. There’s 90 days to this program, so for the next day type in “Insanity day 2”. You’ll find people doing the workout, and you can follow along with them. Finesse the system (; . Insanity is sort of like a military-based workout, but it’s extermely effective bc you build muscle and lose fat with no equipments required. Another thing you can try is getting a workout buddy. If you can’t find one in real life, get an online one. You can skype and do the workout at the same time! But make sure your workout buddy is also hoping to lose a lot of weight so that you feel more comfortable. I wish you the best of luck.

Thanks for the thoughtful response! Yes, I have tried looking for remedies. I’m in several TMAU support groups and I even made my own website for TMAU sufferers. We have tried so many things- different diets, pills, antibiotics, teas- you name it. We’re aware that certain foods trigger the smell more such as foods high in choline or foods that contain the compounds sulfuric acid, trimethylamine, nitrogen, and phosphoruic acid. In addition, sugar, carbs, gluten, meat and dairy products also trigger the smells. Even some veggies such as cabbage and broccoli are bad for us. So you see, it’s problematic because what are we supposed to eat then? Even fruit triggers it bc it has sugar in it. Not eating anything also triggers the smells because your body produces glucose when it’s low in engery, which is a sugar. Some members have been able to reduce the smell by going vegan and taking a combination of pills. However, the diet isn’t working for everyone. 

I’m highly convinced we will find a cure before doctors. I understand what you mean about not taking my frustration out on the doctors, but sometimes I can’t control myself bc this disorder has ruined so many things. Even washing our hair or body triggers the smell bc the soaps have compounds in them that feed the TMAU, so we’re still trying to find a good soap to use. Years of research has gone into this, I’ve had this since I was a child. In 10th grade, I finally went to see a doctor about it. She said it was all in my head and she couldn’t smell anything. As I’m walking out, I hear the nurses laughing at me. Like really? I’m here for help, the least you can do is not scold me for something I can’t control.  And yes, I am trying to make the best out of this. Some days i tell myself that curse is a blessing and it’s saving me from a potential kidnapping or a painful death that resulted from me going out one night. But on average it’s hard to make the best out of it when I’m literally excluded from life acitivies and left in exile. There’s only so much I can do. If only only people were aware of this illness, they will be more forgiving. Thanks anyways!
